use default

is_curzon(base: int, n: int) -> bool is
    let divisor = bigint(base * n + 1)
    let big_base = bigint(base)
    let power = bigint.mod_pow(big_base, bigint(n), divisor)

    return (power + 1n) % divisor =~ 0n
si

curzon_numbers(base: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let n mut = 1

    while true do
        if is_curzon(base, n) then
            yield n
        fi
        n = n + 1
    od
si

for base in [2, 4, 6, 8, 10] do
    write_line("generalized Curzon numbers with base {base}:")

    let first_50 = curzon_numbers(base) |> take(50) |> collect_list()

    for row in 0..5 do
        let cells = (0..10)
            |> map(column => "{first_50[row * 10 + column],5}")

        write_line(cells |> join(""))
    od

    let thousandth = (curzon_numbers(base) |> skip(999) |> first())!

    write_line("the one thousandth: {thousandth}")
    write_line("")
od
